title: Native item anchor (PROPOSED, NPTD-v0.3 §10.2)
description: A stable pointer to a native thread, turn, item or plan revision, with this deliverable's display state, offered so that DEL-01-04 (a request card pointing at its item) and DEL-04-03 (a subject reference) can cite what DEL-01-03 shows. An offered interface: DEL-01-03 consumes nothing from those receivers (R17-10). Names are Chirality's own; Codex identities are carried as data.

nativeKind.description: The supplier's item type value, unchanged (for example commandExecution)

displayState.description: not-completed: opened and never completed by its turn's end (G-4); unknown: no end observed
